title: F-53 manual payment writes XREF1/XREF2='HQ' instead of 'JAK' for Jakarta user
primary_subject: AL_JONATHAN USR05.Y_USERFO='HQ' → XREF tagging wrong on all his F-53 postings
root_cause_summary: AL_JONATHAN's USR05 SU3 parameter Y_USERFO='HQ' instead of 'JAK'. YRGGBS00 form UXR1 (line 996) writes bseg_xref1 = usr05-parva unconditionally (guard commented out). UXR2 (line 1024) writes bseg_xref2 = usr05-parva when XREF2 is blank (always true on F-53 since the screen hides the field). Both run at callpoint 3 under GB922 SUBSTID='UNESCO' steps 005/006 with empty GB905 prerequisites (fires unconditionally on every BSEG line). The code works as designed; the defect is master data only. Independent confirmation via A_HIZKIA (also Jakarta, Y_USERFO='JAK' verified) manually correcting his docs via FBL3N since 2026-02-16. End-to-end gap: VALID='UNES' (12 steps in GB931) has ZERO steps that check XREF fields; F-53/FBZ2 is in ZERO validation prerequisites; 21,754 manual FBL3N/FBL1N/FB02 corrections in Q1 2026 on UNES BELEG by 242 users show this is systemic.

title: Budget Rate custom solution allows cross-currency consumption against EUR-reserved FR -> AVC pool drift -> FMAVC005
reporter: Laetitia Vonthron (adm.cad) -> Christina Lopez-Chemouny -> Yimiao Guo -> Illya Konakov -> Pablo Lopez
primary_subject: FR 3250117351 line 39 (EUR carryforward to 2026, fund 3110111021 / FUNDSCTR PAX / CMMTITEM TC); EqG ticket reimbursement for SG Bivini Mangue
error_messages: FMAVC005 Annual budget exceeded by 0,87 USD (FM Availability Control) for document item 00002
root_cause_summary: 15-member ZFIX_EXCHANGERATE composite has gate-input asymmetry: Camp A (FR-anchored: CHECK_CONS, EF_FUND_RESERVATION, FUNDBLOCK) always fires for EUR FRs; Camp B (posting-anchored: PAYCOMMIT, NEW_ITEM, AVC, KBLEW, FI) silently skips when posting currency is not EUR. FR persisted at BR (1.09529); consumption persisted at identity. AVC pool drifts fund-by-fund until cover-group hits zero headroom. Vonthron's fund 3110111021/PAX/TC has $12,897.80 budget exactly matched by $12,897.80 of carryforward FR commitments -> Available=0 -> any new USD posting fires FMAVC005.
code_validation_chain: extracted_code/CLAS/YCL_FM_BR_EXCHANGE_RATE_BL/CM00A line 8: APPEND 'EUR' to mr_waers (the perimeter line)
extracted_code/CLAS/YCL_FM_BR_EXCHANGE_RATE_BL/CM004: check_conditions exits abap_false if iv_waers NOT IN mr_waers
ZFIX_EXCHANGERATE_CHECK_CONS Enh1 (Camp A): iv_waers = m_r_doc->m_f_kblk-waers (FR header EUR) -> PASS -> recalc -> Enh2 RESTORE original (in-memory only, no persistence)
ZFIX_EXCHANGERATE_NEW_ITEM (Camp B): iv_waers = c_f_fmoi-twaer (USD for USD posting) -> FAIL -> no recalc
ZFIX_EXCHANGERATE_AVC Enh1+3 (Camp B): iv_waers = <ls_fmioi>-twaer / <ls_fmifiit>-twaer per-row -> mixed, USD rows skip
ZFIX_EXCHANGERATE_KBLEW (Camp B): iv_waers = ls_tr_kblew-waers (USD) -> FAIL -> no recalc
ZFIX_EXCHANGERATE_FI (Camp B): iv_waers = <ls_fmifiit>-twaer (USD) -> FAIL -> no recalc + no audit + mt_avc_fund not appended -> fmavc_reinit_on_event handler never registered
FMAVCT(RLDNR=9H,RFIKRS=UNES,RYEAR=2026,RFUND=3110111021,RFUNDSCTR=PAX,RCMMTITEM=TC) ALLOCTYPE_9=KBFC HSL01=12,897.80 USD
Open FR commitments same key: 5 lines (RFPOS 38/39/40/43/45 of FR 3250117351) summing to $12,897.80
Available = 12,897.80 - 12,897.80 = 0 -> FMAVC005 fires on any positive posting

Stops drift at user-input layer.

root_cause_mechanism: PUT_BSIS SELECT on table BSIS ran past rdisp/max_wprun_time via a non-selective access path. Two drivers: (1) HKONT scope possibly resolved from a YBANK_* set; J_DAVANEs primary GL 0001094424 (ECO09 MZN) is NOT in any YBANK_* set (233 of 383 distinct T012K HKONTs uncovered, 61 percent); empty set expansion degrades SELECT to BUKRS-only scan = 2,005,304 BSIS rows for UNES. (2) BUDAT / AUGDT range open combined with (1). SAP-note text embedded in the dump explicitly names access without suitable index and result set too large. Batch executions of YTBAE002 succeeded 5 times in March 2026 (TBTCO status F) because batch has no dispatcher time cap -- dialog vs batch is the trigger, not UBA01 config churn.

root_cause_mechanism_detail: YTBAE002.abap:27 declares CONSTANTS: GC_MOD TYPE C VALUE 'E' (SAP CALL TRANSACTION mode 'Display errors only, opens SAPGUI on BDC error'). The program issues four CALL TRANSACTION ... USING BDCDTAB MODE GC_MOD MESSAGES INTO Y_MESSTAB inside the GET bsis / LDB_PROCESS iteration body: YTBAE002.abap:723 (FB08 reverse), :771 (F-04 post-with-clearing), :819 (FBRA reset cleared), :853 (FB08 second branch). On slow WAN paths (Maputo field office) the cumulative GUI round-trip per BDC error exceeds rdisp/max_wprun_time → dispatcher aborts with TIME_OUT at whatever SELECT the work-process is waiting in (SAPDBSDF:1983 PUT_BSIS in this case). Errors are already captured in Y_MESSTAB at each call site and persisted by PROC_RECONCIL_MESS_ADD at :754/:795/:840/:874 into GT_RECONCIL_MESS for the list output — so silent capture is already wired. Fix: change line 27 'E' → 'N'.

title: F.05 FX revaluation: 'Account 1109574 blocked for posting' (Banco de Chile)
primary_subject: FX revaluation balance-sheet adjustment account blocked
scenario: F.05/SAPF100 (variant UNES_UNBA) revalues active CLP/USD Banco de Chile bank accounts. It posts the FX balance-sheet adjustment to the account configured in OB09/T030H (LKORR). That account is the CLOSED sub 1109574/1109571, blocked for posting.
error_messages: Account 1109574 UNES is blocked for posting
root_cause_summary: Unfinished bank sub-account migration. The Banco de Chile sub was retired (old 1109574 closed -> new 1110574 created) but OB09 was never repointed; the active main still points its LKORR adjustment to the closed sub. Two conditions needed for the runtime error: (1) OB09 points to a blocked sub AND (2) the main carries an FX balance to revalue.

scope: 2 accounts in the failing variant range (1010574 CLP, 1010571 USD); 4 more share the defect but are out of variant scope.
fix_path: OB09/KDF: repoint 0001010574 -> 1110574 and 0001010571 -> 1110571 (active subs, like Ecobank 1094316->1194316). Do NOT unblock the closed subs. Confirm migration target with Treasury.

Account currency from SKAT text + doc currency, not SKB1.WAERS.

title: Ticket 180995 — two sibling transports from one ticket reached P01 101 days apart (MZ payroll currency setup)
reporter: JP Lopez (surfaced reviewing the PY-Finance companion, Session #60)
primary_subject: Transport D01K9B0CDZ (Mozambique MZN wage type 5$B3) vs sibling D01K9B0CE6 (Sri Lanka LKR 5$B4)
root_cause_summary: Not a runtime failure. Ticket 180995 required two parallel Field-Office currency setups. FP_SPEZZANO released both transports on 2024-11-19 within 6 hours of each other, structurally identical (8 table keys each: T042Z/T042ZT payment method + the 5-table wage-type chain T512T/T512W/T52DZ/T52EL/T52EZ). Sri Lanka imported to P01 the next day; Mozambique imported 2025-02-28 — a 101-day divergence. Which of the three hypotheses applies (deliberate staggered rollout / parked in the STMS queue / awaiting FO approval) cannot be separated from the data: TMSALOG is capped at ~1000 rows via RFC and the 2024-11 to 2025-02 window has cycled out. The confirmed root cause is structural, not per-transport: UNESCO has NO control that checks whether siblings of one ticket land in P01 together, and the link ticket->transport exists only as free text in E07T (no foreign key), so the divergence is invisible by construction.

title: ABAP class loss/corruption on D01 caused by our own ADT-over-RFC write client (June 2026)
reporter: JP Lopez — 'Claude processes deleted class definitions, at least 14 lost' (2026-06-12)
primary_subject: 4 FI classes damaged on D01 by in-place ADT writes; 14 N_MENARD classes used as live write-test targets
error_messages: ResourceNotFound (ADT write against an already-deleted object)
root_cause_summary: A write-capable ADT-over-RFC client built 2026-06-07 wrote and activated EXISTING D01 classes in place — no transport, no review, and on objects we do not own (N_MENARD's). Two corruption paths, both proven from the client's own source: (1) lossy read-then-restore — read_source() falls back to CLIF_GET_SOURCE via RFC_ABAP_INSTALL_AND_RUN with WRITE:/ lv where lv is c(255), so the readback is truncated at 255 chars per line and carries report headings; writing that back as the 'restore' mangles the class; (2) writing to a class with missing/invalid SEOCLASS metadata leaves it unrecoverable — the client's own docstring records this, meaning the SEOCLASS pre-flight guard was added AFTER the damage. The deeper cause is process, not code: a RELEASED transport is the unit of change, and in-place ADT writing bypasses it entirely.

probe_deploy_real_change.py (2026-06-07 12:21) = read -> modify -> write -> activate -> 'restore' original (restore failure leaves the class emptied)

TADIR present + SEOCLASS absent for the other ~11/41 = pre-existing intentional deletions (debris), NOT loss
Recovery: transport of copies V01K910259, V01 -> D01, same transport domain DOMAIN_P01, 'Overwrite Originals', target client 350
Post-recovery SEOCLASSDF state=1 for all recovered classes; method counts match baseline (32 / 1 / 54); VRSD version history survived the deletion

title: Add Egypt to the mandatory purpose-of-payment country list (Citi CBE requirement, effective 2026-09-05)
reporter: Mathewos Mehari (BFM) via Christina Lopez-Chemouny; originating notice from Citibank Egypt 2026-07-12
primary_subject: Country EG in the purpose-of-payment configuration
root_cause_summary: Not a defect. Regulatory change: Citibank Egypt requires Purpose of Payment on all RTGS and Cross-Border Funds Transfers to/from Egypt from 2026-09-05, in the Transaction Details field or SWIFT Field 70. UNESCO already runs a purpose-code framework for 9 countries; Egypt has to be added to it. The work is configuration in three maintained tables, zero ABAP.
authority: Citibank Egypt notice, 2026-07-12 — 'payment instructions ... which do not include Purpose of Payment will not be processed', effective 2026-09-05
Request from Mathewos Mehari 2026-08-10: 'include this with the list of the countries which need this information'
code_validation_chain: Citi notice names SWIFT Field 70 -> ISO 20022 RmtInf/Ustrd -> YTFI_PPC_TAG TAG_ID='USTRD' (the family BH/ID/IN/JO/MA/MY/PH use), NOT INSTRINF (= SWIFT :72, used by AE/CN)
YRGGBS00:1547-1590 FORM u917 -> SELECT ytfi_ppc_struc WHERE land1 = <LFBK-BANKS> AND ppc_code IN ('PPC_VAR','PPC_DESCR') -> b_result = b_false: the row type IS the switch
YCL_IDFI_CGI_DMEE_UTIL::GET_TAG_VALUE_FROM_CUSTO:91-169 -> block semantics; T015L-ZWCK1 SPLIT AT SPACE: PPC_VAR = first word, PPC_DESCR = the rest
P01 GB931 -> VALID='UNES' has 12 steps, u917 is 012; no other institute's validation can contain it -> capture reaches company code UNES only

P01 T042E UNES/3 -> ZFORN='Y110_PRENUM_CHCK' no PMW; T042Z FR/3 = manual pre-numbered cheque PROGN=RFFOUS_C XSCHK='X'; REGUT and PAYR have no row for the 5 most recent Egypt runs -> no SAP payment file on this path
u917 body contains ZERO occurrences of yxuser/xtype -> the super-user bypass does NOT apply to this control (only U913 among the 8 blocking routines carries it)

scope.population_bound_by_citi: 387 REGUH lines settling at an Egyptian bank (UBNKS='EG'), 100% company code UNES / house bank CIT19 / method 3
scope.wider_population: 17,778 lines to Egypt-domiciled payees: UNES 16,058 · ICTP 1,242 · UIL 348 · IIEP 117 · UIS 9 · UBO 4

fix_path.immediate: Three maintained tables, no ABAP: (1) YTFI_PPC_STRUC rows for LAND1='EG', TAG_ID='USTRD', DEB_CRE='C' — pay type O carries PPC_VAR + PPC_DESCR + PAY_FIELD FPAYP-XBLNR (PPC_DESCR is the load-bearing block because Citi asks for a narrative, not a code); pay types P and R carry FIXED_VAL. (2) T015L EG* entries, ZWCK1 = '<code> <narrative>'. (3) YTFI_PPC_TAG one row EG/USTRD/C -> RmtInf/Ustrd.
fix_path.structural: Decide whether ICTP/IIEP/UBO/UIL/UIS get an equivalent step in their own validation — KU-2026-099-INSTITUTE-COVERAGE.
preventive: Configuring Egypt buys the CAPTURE only: this payment path emits no SAP file, so the actual instruction is issued outside SAP and someone must populate the Purpose of Payment there — KU-2026-099-EGYPT-INSTRUCTION-CHANNEL
Confirm with CitiService Egypt whether a code prefix is wanted or narrative only
Agree the T015L reason list with BFM/Treasury — it is UNESCO's own taxonomy worded to Citi's standard, not a bank-issued code list

open_followups: T015L reason list — BUSINESS INPUT from BFM/Treasury, blocks entry
Code prefix or narrative only — ask CitiService Egypt
Who fills the Purpose of Payment in the bank portal before 2026-09-05 — Treasury + Cairo office
Whether the other five institutes get the control — Marlies Spronk + N_MENARD + Pablo Lopez
side_findings: The request as phrased ('add Egypt to the list of mandatory purpose code countries') is correct; the list is YTFI_PPC_STRUC and the switch is a PPC_VAR/PPC_DESCR row
The control keys on the vendor's BANK country (LFBK-BANKS), not the address country
This path produces no payment file at all, so the rendering half of the framework is moot for Egypt
lessons: The bank's own notice decided the structure: naming SWIFT Field 70 fixes the tag family to RmtInf/Ustrd and removes the only structural choice there was.
A regulatory request that asks for a 'description' is not a code-list request — Egypt is a PPC_DESCR country, not a PPC_VAR one.
Capture and rendering must be reasoned about separately: a country can need the first and have no use for the second.
chain_anchor_note: Anchored on the Citi notice (the authority), on YRGGBS00 u917 and the UTIL builder source for the mechanism, on live P01 GB931/T042E/T042Z/REGUT/PAYR for coverage and payment medium, and on Gold DB REGUH/LFA1 for the population.
